page.overview:
What is "Changeling" Mark 71NB?

The "Changeling" Mark 71NB was a type of racing starfighter. Ace Squadron pilot Bo Keevil flew one, the Yellow Ace, during the New Republic Era.

The "Changeling" Mark 71NB first appeared in part one of the two-part episode "The Recruit," The model was identified in the 2019 reference book Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition.

The model was named by Adam Bray in reference to Mark Newbold, with "71" referencing his birth year and "NB" referencing "Newbold."
